title: Fresh-target single-factor K=75 signed-expanded hash-slot-capacity control against matched rho

continuation.prerequisite: TASK-20260921-6ae79e must independently validate parent source closure, correctness, and cold-process accounting. A non-validation, material caveat, missing artifact, or pending primary review refuses all successor solver preflight and science.
continuation.primary_review_readback: The parent primary review is sealed with passed verdict: 88 snapshot hashes, all 96 receipts/raw outputs/target equations, source delta, 12 equivalence pairs, cold accounting, and bootstrap agree. Historical attempt-3 digest-schema evolution is nonblocking because final-parser v2 is admitted correct. Separately registered post-hoc diagnostics remain in progress; final parent acceptance/disposition remains reserved until that agent completes.

permitted: one finite public-synthetic explicit-known-answer implementation observation at the exact declared boundary
separate wall, CPU, RSS, and stage measurements
prohibited: private-key recovery; imported, public-unknown, or live targets
batch amortization, shared logs/state, target reuse, or weakened rho
asymptotic, SOTA, security, or cryptanalytic-break conclusions
claim_boundary.no_promotion_rule: A threshold pass remains a finite observation awaiting predeclared independent review and cannot itself change any status.

common_baseline.description: Parent allocation-only ARM IC source at eta=1/256 and K=75.

candidate.description: Common baseline plus the sole permitted capacity delta.
candidate.functional_delta: Inside CompactPairTable::with_capacity, calculate capacity = expected.max(2).next_power_of_two(); multiply capacity by 2 only when x_only=true, the signed-expanded path.
invariants: All other arrays scale from resulting capacity exactly as existing code defines.
Bloom bits are computed from original expected and are unchanged.
No field math, base, density, witness policy, target generation, rho, threads, CLI, reduction, relation policy, or other flag changes.

rho.description: Unchanged common-ARM rho baseline, with no weakening.

source_and_arms.arm_backend_requirement: Every process reports its actual field-arithmetic backend. Common ARM PMULL must be available and used for all three arms; fallback selection refuses science on this host.

frozen_targets_and_order.known_answer_construction: For i=1..24, d_i = 1 + int.from_bytes(SHA256(UTF8('CSIC53-CAPACITY-v1-case-' + two_digit_decimal_i)), 'little') mod (r-1), with r=21044858204113 and i formatted 01..24. Each d_i is an explicit public synthetic known scalar.
frozen_targets_and_order.freshness_gate: Before any preflight or scientific process, hash-pin a manifest proving the 24 d_i are pairwise distinct and disjoint from every parent calibration and held-out scalar. Any collision refuses the run; no scalar, label, seed, count, or order may change to repair it.
frozen_targets_and_order.direct_seed_construction: For i, direct label CSIC53-CAPACITY-v1-direct-seed-XX is shared by both IC arms. CLI uint64 seed is first eight SHA-256 bytes of UTF-8 label interpreted little-endian.
frozen_targets_and_order.rho_seed_construction: For i, rho label CSIC53-CAPACITY-v1-rho-seed-XX derives CLI uint64 identically.
frozen_targets_and_order.assignment: Use those permutations for cases 1-6 and repeat identically for 7-12, 13-18, and 19-24. Each arm occupies each position eight times. Each case launches its three arms in assigned order, serially, in fresh per-child processes/directories without state/log/cache sharing or retries.

preflight.implementation_and_test_permission: Source implementation, offline builds, runner/analyzer work, and unit tests are permitted now. They are not solver controls or scientific measurements and must remain separately recorded.
preflight.conditional_entry_gate: The parent primary-review prerequisite and complete source/custody gate pass before any of the three untimed solver controls. All 72 scientific children remain refused until those controls and every other admission condition pass.

untimed_controls.command_rule: Leading placeholders are replaced by hash-pinned executable paths; literal binary is never an argv token.
requirements: Actual common ARM PMULL backend is reported by every arm.
Complete parent/child receipts, proof checks, scalar 17 and group identity verify.
Baseline/candidate have identical base hash, point/label set, active pair domain, and bounded-n13 lookup semantics.
Do not require identical first-hit transcripts, witness sequence, relation transcript, or rank-prefix trajectory across capacities.
Preflight timings/CPU/RSS/profiling never enter science analysis.

source_and_code_freeze: Before any untimed child, bind parent/candidate source inputs, exact one-factor diff, lockfiles/dependency closure, toolchain, binary hashes, case-generator, runner, analyzer, and control-checker hashes.
Audit shows only the CompactPairTable x_only capacity expression differs, apart from mechanical arm identification/receipt reporting.
Admission is source-only capacity delta plus exact bounded-n13 lookup-semantic controls; no expensive timed support-digest scan.

A cfg(test)-only structural harness may be appended identically to baseline and candidate test copies. It may emit untimed canonical base/domain/lookup digests, but is excluded from release measurement code and introduces no extra production source delta.

semantic_and_correctness_controls.full_scientific_requirement: Every included N=53 process has valid known-answer recovery, group identity, complete receipt, actual backend report, and valid transcript under its capacity configuration.
semantic_and_correctness_controls.structural_requirement: Enumerate the deterministic n=13/a=0/eta=1/2 base pair domain. For both capacities, exhaustively confirm x membership and returned-witness group identity for that domain, plus equal canonical base/domain/lookup digests. These establish the same mathematical object, not equal internal hash-sensitive traces.
semantic_and_correctness_controls.forbidden_false_control: Different witness order, relation transcript, first-hit event, or rank prefix must not reject the capacity candidate by themselves.
semantic_and_correctness_controls.failure_handling: Source-delta violation, failed semantic control, wrong scalar/group identity, missing receipt/backend/telemetry, timeout, crash, or cap event is preserved and invalidates its comparison. It is never mathematical evidence and is never retried.

measurement_and_analysis.process_boundary: Whole process launch through wait4 reap, including setup, table construction, relation/query/solve/validation/receipt stages, and exit. Build/toolchain cost is separate and never amortized.
measurement_and_analysis.primary_metric: For each fresh target i, q_i = candidate whole-process wall seconds / matched rho whole-process wall seconds. Primary statistic is median(q_i) across all 24 valid pairs.
measurement_and_analysis.primary_finite_signal_predicate: Eligible only if all 24 candidate/rho pairs have valid correctness/telemetry, median(q_i) < 0.95, and a paired-bootstrap 95% median upper endpoint < 1.00.

bootstrap.percentile_rule: Parent-compatible Hyndman-Fan type-7 interpolation at 2.5% and 97.5% of the sorted bootstrap medians.
bootstrap.method: paired resampling of all 24 q_i values with replacement; freeze analyzer and reproducible derivation before timing

secondary_metrics: candidate/baseline matched wall, CPU, and peak-RSS ratios plus raw arm values
each direct capacity arm versus matched rho reported separately
direct stage values, including setup/query, without replacing the primary whole-process boundary
measurement_and_analysis.no_selection_rule: No calibration, selection, rerun, best-of choice, or old-result pooling. Targets, seeds, order, capacity, density, and analysis are fixed before timing.

resources_and_stopping.polling_boundary: One millisecond is requested, not guaranteed; record actual sampling method. Wall ends only at wait4 reap.
resources_and_stopping.memory_sampling_boundary: Sample memory footprint independently at requested 50 ms intervals. This is distinct from the requested 1 ms wait4/poll loop and is likewise not a guaranteed OS scheduling bound; record actual sample times and method.
resources_and_stopping.memory_boundary: 8 GiB is cooperative on Darwin. Record sampling availability and cap events. Aggregate RUSAGE_CHILDREN maximum RSS is prohibited; CPU/RSS must be per-PID wait4 or child-receipt fields with units/method.
resources_and_stopping.no_retry_rule: Every launched scientific process occupies its frozen case/arm slot once. Failures remain indexed, never rerun, dropped, imputed, or made mathematical.
resources_and_stopping.anomaly_stop: Cross-child inheritance, source/binary mismatch, unexpected backend, target collision, or correctness violation stops further launches after current child pending an additive amendment.

artifacts.immutability: No artifact, including failure receipts, is overwritten; corrections are additive with supersession links.

executor_binding.requirement: Dispatcher records actual resolved identity and verification before work; a nonconforming model is refused rather than degraded.

inference.parent_failure_boundary: Prior terra failures remain immutable parent artifacts, not successor measurements or grounds to alter counts/criteria/binding.
